$4,500 / $4,000Option 1 — 180h / 160hReplicate + improvements (§3). Separate layouts / shared layouts (§2.1)

3 storesThree separate Shopify stores, each with its own admin, under one account

Your three sites run today as store views of one Magento install. We move them to three Shopify stores managed from a single Shopify account, and give you two ways to do it: keep the current look and fix what holds it back (Option 1), or design a new interface for all three (Option 2). This document lists what changes on each site, the hours and the price for both options.

See it first: we built a homepage mockup for ATV & Fritid so you can see what Option 1 looks like on your own content: preview.litos.io/atv-fritid

All three run on one Magento install with separate store views, and each site has its own homepage, collection and product page layout. On Shopify each site becomes a separate store with its own admin, catalog, orders and settings, all managed from one Shopify account.

2.1 Lower price with shared layouts

Today each site has its own homepage, collection and product page layout, and the prices above keep it that way. If you agree to use one theme for all three stores, with the same collection and product page layout, we build those pages once and reuse them. Each store still keeps its own logo, colors, homepage and content.

3

Option 1: what we improve on each site

These changes are included in the Option 1 hours. The ATV & Fritid mockup (preview.litos.io/atv-fritid) shows the direction for all three.

3.1 atv-fritid.se — header

TodayPlain search box and text links for login, with no hint of what customers can search for.

ProposedWider search that tells customers they can search by article number or model, and clear icons for "Butiker", "Logga in" and "Kundvagn".

3.2 atv-fritid.se — product card

TodayBig "Sale" circles, centered text and a small button. Customers can't see the brand or whether the item is in stock.

ProposedDiscount shown as a percentage, brand above the name, stock status with the store location ("I lager · Söderköping") and a full-width "Lägg i kundvagn" button.

3.3 atv-fritid.se — footer and collections

We keep your current footer content and fix the spacing, or move it to a cleaner column layout like the two examples below. On collection pages we add filters.

ReferenceBRP (another site): three clear columns and a row of brand logos. A good fit for the brands you carry.

ReferenceJettribe (another site): more columns, with contact details, newsletter and payment logos in one place.

3.4 jetskiparts.se — colors and header

TodayPeach, grey and black don't work together, and the search and cart sit apart from the logo. We rebalance the colors and bring logo, search and cart into one row.

3.5 jetskiparts.se — hero images

The hero shows products only. Photos of people riding sell the product better. We set up the hero for lifestyle images; the photos come from you or your suppliers.

ReferenceAnother site: one strong action photo with a short headline.

ReferenceJettribe (another site): products shown on real riders.

3.6 jetskiparts.se — parts finder

If you sell parts for many makes and models, a "Make / Year / Model" finder lets customers see only the parts that fit their machine. We place it in the hero or right below it.

ReferenceAnother site: a simple finder bar with three dropdowns.

ReferenceAnother site: the same finder placed inside the hero, so it's the first thing customers see.

Parts finder: on Shopify this needs a fitment app, paid by you, and your products need make/year/model data. We confirm the app and the data source with you before building (§6, question 3).

3.7 jetskiparts.se — categories

Today"Top Kategorier" tiles are small and look like product cards, so they get lost. We make them larger and visually different from products.

ReferenceAnother site: large photo tiles with bold labels.

ReferenceAnother site: a category grid with product counts, which suits a parts catalog.

ReferenceAnother site: a category slider that mixes one lifestyle photo with product tiles.

3.8 jetskiparts.se — homepage content and filters

We add a "shop the look" section where customers click points on a photo to see the products, a banner or video block (riding, surfing) and customer testimonials. On collection pages we add filters for price, brand and other attributes.

ReferenceAnother site: hotspots on a photo link to the products in it.

Who configures what

Payment and shipping are set up by you in each Shopify admin. We guide you and verify the result, but we don't enter the credentials. They give access to your money and your carrier rates, so they stay with the account holder.

ItemYou doWe do
Payment providerOpen the account, enter the credentials, run the first live order on each storeGive you a step-by-step guide, test checkout
Shipping zones & ratesEnter zones and rates, keep them up to dateWalk you through it, test real addresses in Sweden and the EU
